subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: William Wordsworth was a great romantic poet. He was born in England. In his childhood, he lost his parents. Then with the help of his relatives, he continued his studies. He wrote his first poem in 1787. After graduating from St. John's College, he along with his friends went to France and Italy. In France he fell in love with a French woman named Annette Vallon. In 1791, he was greatly influenced by the French, Revolution. Wordsworth and his close friend, another romantic poet S.T. Coleridge jointly published 'Lyrical Ballads' in 1798. They explained new poetic theory in this book. Finally Wordsworth became the poet laureate of England.
